bio: Located some way out of the city, ‘Knife and Fork’ is a modern, understated restaurant that’s run well by an engaging team. The small space has a relaxed atmosphere, while the menu is underpinned by modern interpretations of traditional Polish recipes. Seasonal produce informs the cooking too, with a tasting menu available at dinner. 'Podążaj za tym co Cię uszczęśliwia' written across the wall means ‘follow what makes you happy’ – and here you will be!...
